name: 🔴 30 Questions with Sapan Verma, Atul Khatri and Abish Mathew (special appearance by @tanmaybhat)
description:
On this episode of 30 Questions, ace comics and friends Sapan Verma, Atul Khatri, Abish Mathew join us to talk about the upcoming season of One Mic Stand, mentoring celebrities, teaching n00bs stand-up, and a bunch of other fun things. 

And then @tanmaybhat drops in and a Merry time is had by allll
